weak.label: Weak
weak.description: Minimum 6 characters. No mixed case, numbers, or symbols required.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Minimum 8 characters, with mixed case letters and at least one number.

strong.label: Strong
strong.description: Minimum 12 characters, mixed case, letters, numbers, symbols, and not found in known data breaches.

project.twoFactorRequired: Require two-factor authentication for all users

project.publicApiDescription: Browser origin allowlist for the public REST and GraphQL API

project.revisionRetentionHint: Leave empty for unlimited on that axis. Applies when a collection does not set its own limit.
project.uploadLimitsDescription: Optional size caps for Files pool and chat attachments. Leave empty for unlimited.
project.uploadLimitsHint: Empty = unlimited. Single-request uploads still cannot exceed PHP upload_max_filesize / post_max_size; larger files use chunked upload.
project.filesDescription: Image transformation options used by the file library
